translated_title: Thousand-Year-Old Maya City Discovered in Campeche
original_title: Descubren en Campeche ciudad maya de mil años de antigüedad
author: Lorenzo Chim
meta_description: Mexican and Slovenian archaeologists used LiDAR to find Minanbé in the Calakmul reserve, with a 13-meter temple and a stela carved with a decapitation scene dated 849.
